The fund's own totals over those windows are computed from its NAV series every run and carry the NAV chip; it is the comparators beside them that age between weekly reads, and on any fund the weekly read refuses. funds.whyNow: The broadening rally thesis. After two years in the shadow of the Magnificent Seven, the Russell 2000 staged a "Great Rotation" in early 2026, outperforming the Nasdaq for a record streak in January. Three drivers: (1) Fed rate cuts reduce floating-rate debt burden — ~40% of Russell 2000 debt is floating vs ~10% for S&P 500, so earnings relief lags cuts by 12–18 months — 2026 is when it lands. (2) Valuation gap — Russell 2000 forward P/E relative to S&P 500 at 0.72x vs historical norm of 0.99x. (3) BofA forecasts 17% earnings growth for small caps vs 14% for large caps. Caveat: ~40% of Russell 2000 companies are loss-making; highly sensitive to rate reversals. Hold as a satellite, not a core.
